avalanche-1-1.text: Avalanche Bowl! The steepest course on this mountain!

avalanche-1-2.text: Steep, fast, and huge air. In this visibility, you ride the flags.

avalanche-2-1.text: Avalanche Bowl! This is the expert course.

avalanche-2-2.text: And the snow is coming down sideways up there!

avalanche-2-3.text: Our camera crew is very, very brave.

avalanche-3-1.text: Avalanche Bowl, in a whiteout! The cameras can barely see!

avalanche-3-2.text: Neither can the rider. Follow the flags!

behind-1-1.text: Oh, and that's a pass! Down to second.

behind-2-1.text: The lead is gone! Come on, come on!

behind-3-1.text: Trailing now. Plenty of mountain left!

behind-4-1.text: No, no, no! Chase it down!

big-1-1.text: Oh my goodness! Did you see that?

big-1-2.text: I saw it! I'm still processing it!

big-2-1.text: That is a big one! Write that down!

big-2-2.text: That is going straight on the highlight reel!

big-3-1.text: Absolutely massive! The crowd is on its feet!

big-4-2.text: She said genuinely! Folks, that never happens!

big-6-1.text: Textbook! Somebody put that in the training video!

crash-1-1.text: Oh! And that is a yard sale!

crash-3-1.text: Ooh, that's going to leave a mark!

crash-4-1.text: Down they go! Up you get, keep it moving!

crash-5-1.text: Wipeout! That is snow in places snow should never be!

crash-6-1.text: That one got away. Happens to the best of them.

crash-7-1.text: Shake it off! Back up and going!

crystal-1-1.text: We are live at Crystal Ridge! Wide open groomers and big, friendly kickers!

crystal-1-2.text: Friendly is a strong word. They're polite.

crystal-2-1.text: Crystal Ridge today! The sun is out, the snow is fast, and there are no excuses on this one.

crystal-3-1.text: Crystal Ridge, and just look at that view from the top!

crystal-3-2.text: Enjoy the view later. Watch the jumps now.

fast-1-2.text: Full tuck! Very aerodynamic, very brave!

fast-2-1.text: That's very fast. Too fast. Perfect.

fast-3-1.text: Full tuck! The speed gun is going crazy!

ident-1-1.text: Good afternoon, everybody, and welcome to live coverage of the Ten-Eighty Mountain Series! I'm Dani Reyes!

ident-1-2.text: And I'm Wren Halvorsen. Fast snow, a hungry field, and Dani has already had two coffees.

ident-2-1.text: Welcome back to the Ten-Eighty Mountain Series! Wren Halvorsen, alongside Dani Reyes.

ident-2-2.text: Wren, it is a gorgeous day up here, and we have got a stacked field!

ident-3-1.text: You are watching the Ten-Eighty Mountain Series, live from the mountain! Four courses! Four riders! One booth!

ident-3-2.text: One booth, with a heater that smells like toast. We have told the network.

ident-4-1.text: If you're just joining us, welcome! The riders are up top, choosing their courses right now.

ident-4-2.text: And the crowd at the finish is loud, folks! I can hear the cowbells from the booth!

ident-5-1.text: Live from the summit, this is the Ten-Eighty Mountain Series! I'm Dani Reyes, and beside me, the sharpest analyst in the sport!

ident-6-1.text: Wren Halvorsen and Dani Reyes, back in the booth together!

ident-6-2.text: Fifteen years, folks! We used to race each other. Now we argue on television!

ident-6-3.text: On live television. Which is so much worse.

idle-1-2.text: Lovely lines! I love a line!

idle-2-3.text: So what's for dinner, on air?

idle-3-1.text: Watch the knees. Soft knees soak up everything.

idle-4-1.text: This is my favorite section of the course!

idle-4-2.text: You say that about every section.

idle-5-1.text: There are free points on those kickers!

idle-5-2.text: Free points are the best points!

idle-6-1.text: I am so proud of every athlete out here today!

idle-7-1.text: The longer you hold a grab, the more it scores.

idle-7-2.text: Grab it like you mean it!

idle-8-1.text: Wren, sum up this run in one word!

idle-9-1.text: Viewers at home, do not try this in your driveway.

idle-9-2.text: Unless your driveway is a mountain!

jules-1-1.text: Jules is in the gate! The big air specialist!

jules-1-2.text: Jules jumps first and does the math in the air.

jules-2-1.text: Jules at the top! Expect altitude.

jules-2-2.text: Expect the cameras to lose the shot!

kai-1-1.text: In the gate, it's Kai! The all-rounder!

kai-1-2.text: Good at everything, great at nothing. A very consistent career.

kai-2-1.text: Kai at the top! Steady hands, steady board.

lead-1-1.text: And that's the lead! Out in front!

lead-2-1.text: A pass, and a very clean one!

lead-3-1.text: Into first place! Go, go, go!

lead-4-1.text: Takes the lead! Now don't give it back.

lose-1-2.text: Run it back! Run it back!

lose-2-2.text: Not today. There's always another run.

lose-4-1.text: Second place is the first loser! I'm kidding! I'm kidding, it's great!

lose-5-2.text: Heads up! That was a good fight!

lose-trees-2-1.text: Second place. And the trees had a say in that one.

lose-trees-2-2.text: The trees are undefeated this season, folks!

lose-trees-3-1.text: Not today! But hey, the tree's okay!

lose-trees-3-2.text: The tree has a better record than most of the field.

menu-1-1.text: While we wait on the next rider, Wren, give the folks at home one thing to watch for!

menu-1-2.text: The landings. Anyone can spin. Not everyone can stop spinning.

menu-11-1.text: Big shout out to the queer ski club, out in force at the bottom of the course today!

menu-11-2.text: They brought a banner. It is very sparkly. The cameras love it.

menu-12-1.text: The nachos at the lodge tonight, folks! I'm just saying! I'm just putting it out there!

menu-12-2.text: Dani will have eaten all of them by four.

menu-2-1.text: A quick stat for the viewers. Dani broke her left collarbone five times in her career.

menu-2-2.text: And I came back every single time!

menu-3-1.text: Wren, you raced boardercross for, what, eight seasons?

menu-3-2.text: Seven. My knees voted on the eighth.

menu-4-1.text: I keep a spreadsheet of every trick landed this season.

menu-4-2.text: Folks, it is color coded! The network wants it on screen, and she will not let them!

menu-5-1.text: The truck is telling us we have a moment before the next run.

menu-5-2.text: Which means Wren is going to talk about wax!

menu-6-1.text: Let's take you up to the start area! The riders are stretching, they're studying the course, they're getting focused!

menu-6-2.text: They're looking at their phones, Dani.

menu-7-1.text: For the viewers at home: first one to the bottom wins. It's not complicated.

menu-7-2.text: It's beautifully simple! That's why we love it!

menu-8-1.text: Now, we did have a moose wander past the finish area earlier.

menu-8-2.text: Course security has asked him to leave.

menu-9-1.text: Conditions across the mountain! Sunshine on Crystal Ridge, golden light in the trees on Timber Run, a whiteout in Avalanche Bowl, and sunset in the pipe!

mika-1-1.text: Mika's in the start gate! A technical rider, and very clean.

mika-1-2.text: Mika's the only athlete on tour who actually reads Wren's spreadsheet!

mika-2-1.text: Here's Mika! Nobody on tour lands cleaner!

pipe-1-1.text: The superpipe! Folks, I spent ten years in this thing!

pipe-2-1.text: The halfpipe! Wall to wall: height, rotation, and a clean landing.

pipe-2-2.text: On both feet, folks! Very important! Both of them!

pipe-3-1.text: Sunset in the pipe! Let's see some spins!

pipe-3-2.text: Clean spins. Rotation without a landing is just falling with ambition.

restart-3-1.text: Back to the top! One more time!

rival-1-1.text: The rival is across the line! Keep pushing, all the way down!

rival-2-1.text: The rival's in! Don't give up, finish it out!

rob-1-1.text: Here comes Rob, and Rob is fast!

rob-1-2.text: Rob turns maybe twice a run. Both by accident.

rob-2-1.text: Rob at the top! A pure speed rider. Tuck, point, and hope.

rob-2-2.text: Hope is a strategy for Rob!

score-1-1.text: What a show! Look at that score!

score-2-1.text: And that's the trick attack! Let's see the total.

score-3-1.text: That's the session! Style for days!

score-3-2.text: Style for one whole run. But good style.

timber-1-1.text: Timber Run! Tight trees, and you have to pick your line early.

timber-1-2.text: And folks, the trees do not move! I have checked! Personally! With my face!

timber-2-1.text: Timber Run, golden hour in the pines! Gorgeous pictures from up top!

timber-2-2.text: Very pretty. The trunks are very hard.

timber-3-1.text: Timber Run is all about rhythm. Turn, turn, breathe.

time-1-1.text: Across the line! Check the clock!

time-1-2.text: Is that a record? It feels like a record!

time-2-1.text: And that's the finish! What a run!

time-2-2.text: The time is on the board.

tree-1-2.text: The tree is fine, by the way.

tree-3-1.text: Oh no, right into the pines!

tree-4-1.text: That's a tree. The tree did not move.

trick-3-1.text: Look at the style on that!

trick-6-1.text: That one's going in the spreadsheet!

win-1-1.text: And that's the win! What a race!

win-2-2.text: I'm getting emotional, folks! I am actually getting emotional!

win-3-1.text: Victory! Somebody get this rider a podium and a plate of nachos!

win-clean-1-1.text: First place, and not a single fall! That is a clean run!

win-clean-2-1.text: The win, and they never touched the snow! Wren, did you see that?

win-clean-2-2.text: Didn't put a foot wrong. That's going in the spreadsheet!
